leaves.name: raynaudSemistableSHOr

IX Prop. 4.7 (number UNVERIFIED) over a strictly henselian DVR, with the conclusion the disjunction of semistability over k(s) (general torus) and on the geometric special fibre. leaves.name: mumfordGroupLawConn

The gluing over connected components is proved (mumfordGroupLaw_of_conn). Replaces mumfordGroupLaw.
leaves.source: Mumford-Fogarty-Kirwan, Geometric Invariant Theory, Thm 6.14 (S connected locally noetherian, F -> S smooth proper with a section e, a fibre an abelian variety: F is an abelian scheme with identity e); numbers UNVERIFIED; dict-models

leaves.name: dsThm965Printed

leaves.name: dsThm966Printed
leaves.doc: Deligne-Serre, Formes modulaires de poids 1, Ann. Sci. ENS (4) 7 (1974), Thm 4.1 with (4.1.1), p. 514, as printed: for f != 0 a (cusp) form of type (1, eps) with eps(-1) = -1 that is an eigenvector of the T_p, p not dividing N, with eigenvalues a_p (Tau Ceti EigenformAwayFromLevel N 1, no normalization a_1 = 1), a continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(C) with finite image, unramified outside N, with tr rho(Frob_p) = a_p (the T_p-eigenvalue F.eigenvalue p) and det rho(Frob_p) = eps(p). The coefficient form a_p = coeff g p (from a_1 = 1) and eps(-1) = -1 (parity lemma, TauCeti Parity.lean:113) are glue in DSThm966EV.dsThm966_of_printed (coeff-fix).
leaves.source: Deligne-Serre 1974 Thm 4.1 (4.1.1), p. 514: f != 0 of type (1, eps), eigenvector of T_p (p not dividing N) with eigenvalues a_p => rho : G_Q -> GL_2(C), unramified outside N, Tr rho(Frob_p) = a_p, det rho(Frob_p) = eps(p)
